title.zh: 查询实时日志投递服务下所有直播域名

descriptions.zh:
- 调用本接口查询实时日志投递服务下所有直播域名，返回的日志服务状态分为正在服务和停止服务。

- 您可调用[DescribeLiveDomainRealtimeLogDelivery](~~2848121~~)查询Project、Logstore、Region参数信息。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为6000次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- This operation queries all streaming domains that are configured for the real-time log delivery service. The response indicates whether the service is online or offline for each domain.

- You can call [DescribeLiveDomainRealtimeLogDelivery](~~2848121~~) to query parameters such as Project, Logstore, and Region.

## QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 6,000 calls per minute. If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled. Throttling may affect your business. We recommend that you call this operation within the specified limit.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live list-live-realtime-log-delivery-domains --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --project project_example --logstore logstore_example --biz-region cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live ListLiveRealtimeLogDeliveryDomains --region cn-hangzhou --Project project_example --Logstore logstore_example --Region 'cn-hangzhou' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
